purpose: Exploratory development-only comparison motivated by baseline failures; not a blind test.
population: All unchanged 45 development questions; reuse the saved first answer when no retry is triggered.
queries: The original user question, independently retrieved with dense then BM25; no answer-derived query and no rewriting model.
context: Retain first two baseline sources, alternate new dense/BM25 branch candidates, fill with remaining old sources; whole chunks within 7400 characters; rebuild citation numbering.
generation: Same baseline DeepSeek model configuration and prompt template; only context changes. Baseline answer is excluded from generation input.
acceptance: Use retry response if nonempty, nontruncated and without invalid citation numbers; otherwise retain baseline. No semantic-score-based winner selection.
review: Same 0/1/2 answer rubric, source-audited AI judgments with independent human review pending. Untouched answers retain their original review.
cost: Report incremental retrieval and model attempts, returned tokens and response latency, including unsuccessful retries; reuse is not a fresh 45-call control run.
adoption: Keep optional until development evidence shows a useful tradeoff; do not alter production defaults or score the 105 test candidates.
